description.portal_value: The Military Industries Corporation (MIC), in collaboration with the Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources (MIM) and the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), is pleased to announce the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) and Request for Qualification (RFQ) phase for the privatization of the Military Uniform and Accessories Factory (MUAF)
description.current_ncp_value: News Return to Media Center 18/09/2025 Previous Next MIC in Collaboration with the Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources and NCP Announces Privatization of the Military Uniform and Accessories Factory Page Image It will also sustain and enhance production capacity for military and non-military uniforms and accessories, while enabling the development of new business opportunities, including entry into B2B markets and export growth Page Content ​​​ Riyadh, September 2025 , The Military Industries Corporation (MIC), in collaboration with the Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources (MIM) and the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), is pleased to announce the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) and Request for Qualification (RFQ) phase for the privatization of the Military Uniform and Accessories Factory (MUAF) project in Riyadh and Al Kharj. The privatization will be executed through a purchase agreement, transferring full ownership of MUAF from MIC to the private sector. The transfer of ownership will ensure compliance with military industry regulations and licensing requirements set by the General Authority for Military Industries (GAMI). It will also sustain and enhance production capacity for military and non-military uniforms and accessories, while enabling the development of new business opportunities, including entry into B2B markets and export growth. In addition, the process will support a smooth transition of operations, workforce, and supply chain management under private ownership. This step highlights the Kingdom's commitment to building a competitive, sustainable, and innovative defense industry ecosystem, while strengthening the overall industrial base. It also creates new opportunities for private sector participation across strategic sectors in line with the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030. Local and international investors are invited to visit the NCP website at www.ncp.gov.sa to review further information and details of the EOI and RFQ. The deadline for submitting SOQ is 16 October 2025, at 03:00 PM (KSA time).​ Share | Print

description.portal_value: This Public-Private Partnership (PPP) project aims to develop and manage modern logistics facilities, warehousing solutions, and operate and maintain the infrastructure in Dammam 2nd Industrial City to enhance Saudi Arabia's logistics infrastructure and support its vision of becoming a global logistics hub. Spanning approximately 850,000 square meters, the project will strategically facilitate trade, cross-border connectivity, and industrial expansion. The zone will include gated and non-gated public areas, leasable spaces, and utilities to enhance trade, connectivity, and industrial expansion.
description.current_ncp_value: News Return to Media Center 09/03/2025 Previous Next MODON and NCP Launch EOI for Logistics Zone Development in Dammam 2nd Industrial City Page Image Launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) for the Logistics Zone Development in Dammam 2nd Industrial City. Page Content ​​ Riyadh, February 2025 – Saudi Authority for Industrial Cities and Technology Zones “MODON", in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), is pleased to announce the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) for the Logistics Zone Development in Dammam 2 nd Industrial City. This project will be executed under a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model through a Design-Build-Finance-Operate–Maintain-Transfer (DBFOMT) contract with a period of 30 years. The Logistics Zone Development Project aims to enhance the Kingdom's logistics infrastructure to support Saudi Arabia's vision of becoming a global logistics hub. Spanning approximately 850,000 square meters, the project is strategically located within Dammam 2 nd Industrial City and will serve as a key enabler for trade, cross-border connectivity, and industrial expansion. The development will include modern logistics facilities, warehousing solutions, and operate and maintain the infrastructure, ensuring seamless integration with both existing and future industrial activities. The site will comprise, among other components, a gated public area, a non-gated public area, leasable spaces, and a dedicated utilities infrastructure area. As part of the project scope, the private sector partner will be responsible for securing financing, designing and constructing leasable areas, and maintaining infrastructure, managing operations and maintenance, and commercializing the project through tenant attraction, leasing, and revenue generation. This project aligns with Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 by fostering private sector participation, driving economic diversification, and strengthening the country's logistics ecosystem. Local and international investors are invited to visit the NCP website at ( www.ncp.gov.sa ) for more information about the project. The deadline for submitting EOIs is March 9 2025, at 3:00 p.m. KSA time. ​ Share | Print

description.portal_value: The project aims to complete and operate the Umm Al-Qura University Hospital through a Public Private Partnership (PPP) model. The hospital infrastructure has a planned total capacity of 391 beds. The project supports medical education, training, and research, while delivering high quality specialized and secondary healthcare services to the population of Makkah.
description.current_ncp_value: News Return to Media Center 30/06/2026 Previous Next Umm Al-Qura University, and NCP Announce Launch of EOI Phase for the Completion and Operation of Umm Al-Qura University Hospital PPP Project Page Image PPP project to complete and operate a 391-bed university hospital, delivering high-quality specialized and secondary healthcare services while supporting medical education, training, and research Page Content Riyadh, June 2026: Umm Al-Qura University, and the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP) announced the launch of the Expressions of Interest (EOI) phase for the completion and operation of Umm Al-Qura University Hospital in the Makkah Region, under a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model through a Design, Build, Finance, Operate, and Maintain (DBFOM) contract for a period of 30 years. The Project aims to revitalize a strategic state asset by activating an existing hospital and transforming it into a fully integrated university hospital operating at full capacity, with a total capacity of 391 beds. The scope of the Project includes the rehabilitation and completion of the remaining construction works for the hospital, in addition to its full operation through the delivery of integrated clinical and healthcare services, including inpatient, outpatient, emergency, surgical, and diagnostic services, along with the provision of core medical specialties and the management of facilities and supporting medical services. The Umm Al-Qura University Hospital Project supports medical education, training, and scientific research for national talent, alongside the delivery of high-quality specialized and secondary healthcare services to the population of the region. The Project is centered on enhancing the optimal use of state assets and achieving financial sustainability in line with Saudi Vision 2030, by enabling the private sector to equip and operate the assets to improve the efficiency of government spending, manage human capital, and ensure integration with the University's medical education and training programs in line with market needs and international best practices. Local and international investors, financial institutions, and operators are invited to visit the NCP website at investors​.ncp.gov.sa for more information about the project and to request the EOI document. Interested investors should submit their EOI by July 21, 2026 at 11:59 PM KSA time. ​ Share | Print

description.portal_value: The Municipal Food Safety Labs Operations Project seeks to build an advanced laboratory infrastructure based on world-class safety and quality standards across the food and water chains, with the aim of strengthening public safety, improving the overall quality of life by upgrading labs using cutting-edge equipment and materials, expanding government lab testing capacity to fulfil growing demand, and ensuring accurate and sufficient testing for food and water products in line with the goals of the Quality of Life program and Saudi Vision 2030.
description.current_ncp_value: News Return to Media Center 01/04/2026 Previous Next MOMAH and NCP Launch EOI to Municipal Food Safety Labs Across Five Municipalities in Saudi Arabia Page Image Developing advanced food safety labs to enhance testing, ensure quality, and protect public health in line with Vision 2030. Page Content Riyadh, April 2026 , the Ministry of Municipalities and Housing (MOMAH) and the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), have announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) stage for the Municipal Food Safety Labs Operation Project under a PPP framework (Equip-Operate-Maintain-Transfer) for a contract duration of 5 years, inviting local, regional, and global companies with experience in lab operations to participate and submit their bids. The project scope includes equipping, operating, and maintaining food safety labs across five municipalities, including Hafr Al Batin, Northern Borders, Tabuk, Qassim, and Al Ahsa. The project aims to upgrade lab equipment, expand chemical and microbiological testing capacity for food and water products, ensure testing accuracy to support the lab compliance value chain, and facilitate ongoing knowledge transfer and end-of-contract handover to the respective municipalities. The Municipal Food Safety Labs Operation Project seeks to boost public health and safety standards for the Kingdom's citizens and residents in line with the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030, besides developing the municipal monitoring ecosystem, optimizing food and water testing, and empowering the private sector to run operations as per global best practices. Once completed, the project will enhance food safety in the Kingdom, enable sustainable growth across targeted regions by creating unique investment opportunities for the private sector, and improve the efficiency of government spending through the PPP model, playing a key role in elevating the quality of municipal services being offered to citizens and residents. Local and international investors, financial institutions, and operators are invited to visit the NCP website at www.investors.ncp​.gov.sa for more information about the project and to request the EOI document. Interested investors should submit their EOI by 15 April 2026 at 11:59 PM KSA time.​ ​ Share | Print

description.current_ncp_value: News Return to Media Center 04/05/2026 Previous Next Saudi Arabia Launches EOI and RFQ Phase for Chronic Kidney Disease Care & National Dialysis Services Page Image A PPP project to provide renal care services to over 11,500 patients across the Kingdom ensuring broad geographic coverage. Page Content ​ Riyadh, May 2026 : The Ministry of Health (MoH), the Ministry of Defense (MoD) and the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP) have announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) and Request for Qualification (RFQ) phase for the Chronic Kidney Disease Care & National Dialysis Services project. The project will be executed under a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model Design, Repurpose, Finance and Maintain (DRFM), with a 6-year contract, in addition to a clinical services model. The project aligns with a key objective of Saudi Vision 2030 by promoting increased private sector participation within the healthcare sector. The MoH is seeking to partner with experienced private operators to deliver comprehensive renal care services to a minimum of 11,500 patients throughout the Kingdom. The project is divided across 4 packages, each serving a minimum number of patients across several regions, to ensure broad geographic coverage and accessibility. Details about the size and geographical coverage of each Package will be provided at the RFP stage. Under this PPP framework, the MoH and the selected private operator for each package will have an agreement, outlining the terms of collaboration. The selected Private Operators will be responsible for providing the necessary facilities, equipment, and IT services. They must also supply qualified staff, manage both clinical (In-center hemodialysis, home hemodialysis, Peritoneal dialysis, vascular access and OPD services) and non-clinical operations. Local and international investors, financial institutions, and operators are invited to visit the NCP website at investors.ncp.gov.sa for more information about the project and to request the RFQ document. Interested investors should submit their Statement of Qualification (SOQ) by June 15, 2026 at 15:00 PM, KSA time.​ Share | Print

Saleh Nasser Al-Jasser, MATARAT Holding, in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), is pleased to announce the launch of Expression of Interest (EOI) stage for the development of Prince Naif bin Abdulaziz International Airport Public Private Partnership Project, inviting bids from local, regional, and international private sector participants for a contract duration of 30 years, including the construction phase. His Excellency, the President of the General Authority of Civil Aviation and Chairman of the Board of MATARAT Holding, Mr. Abdulaziz bin Abdullah Al-Duailej, stated that the issuance of the Request for Expression of Interest reflects the civil aviation system's commitment to empowering and engaging the private sector, while fostering high value investment partnerships in the airport sector. He emphasized that this step would help enhance infrastructure development, improve operational efficiency, and elevate the quality of services provided to travelers. His Excellency further highlighted that the development project of Prince Naif bin Abdulaziz International Airport in Qassim represents a strategic initiative that supports the objectives of the Aviation Program stems from the National Transport and Logistics Strategy. The project, he noted, underscores the aviation ecosystem's dedication to attracting both local and international investments, strengthening the competitiveness of regional airports, and advancing economic and tourism growth across the Kingdom, in alignment with the goals of Saudi Vision 2030. Prince Naif bin Abdulaziz International Airport development project aligns with Vision 2030's goals which aims to enhance the growth of the aviation sector in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Through the National Transport and Logistics Strategy and the Aviation Program derived from it, the Kingdom seeks to strengthen its position among the leading nations as a global logistics hub connecting three continents. The project scope includes the development and operation of Prince Naif bin Abdulaziz International Airport, covering design, financing, construction, transfer, operations and maintenance. The project site is located 25 kilometers from Buraidah in the Qassim region, and the proposed scope includes a fully equipped passenger terminal to accommodate the airport's expected demand, along with supporting service facilities and the development of airside infrastructure, including runway, taxiways, and aprons. His Excellency, the President of the General Authority of Civil Aviation and Chairman of the Board of MATARAT Holding, Mr. Abdulaziz bin Abdullah Al-Duailej, stated that the issuance of the Request for Expression of Interest reflects the civil aviation system's commitment to empowering and engaging the private sector, while fostering high value investment partnerships in the airport sector. He emphasized that this step would help enhance infrastructure development, improve operational efficiency, and elevate the quality of services provided to travelers. His Excellency further highlighted that the development project of Prince Naif bin Abdulaziz International Airport in Qassim represents a strategic initiative that supports the objectives of the Aviation Program stems from the National Transport and Logistics Strategy. The project, he noted, underscores the aviation ecosystem's dedication to attracting both local and international investments, strengthening the competitiveness of regional airports, and advancing economic and tourism growth across the Kingdom, in alignment with the goals of Saudi Vision 2030. Prince Naif bin Abdulaziz International Airport development project aligns with Vision 2030's goals which aims to enhance the growth of the aviation sector in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Through the National Transport and Logistics Strategy and the Aviation Program derived from it, the Kingdom seeks to strengthen its position among the leading nations as a global logistics hub connecting three continents. The project scope includes the development and operation of Prince Naif bin Abdulaziz International Airport, covering design, financing, construction, transfer, operations and maintenance. The project site is located 25 kilometers from Buraidah in the Qassim region, and the proposed scope includes a fully equipped passenger terminal to accommodate the airport's expected demand, along with supporting service facilities and the development of airside infrastructure, including runway, taxiways, and aprons. description.portal_value:
The King Fahd Suburb Boulevard project is a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) opportunity located in Al Baida Governorate, Dammam, Eastern Region. The Project aims to develop an integrated, mixed-use urban destination. Spanning approximately 1,000,000 square meters, it will be developed in two phases, encompassing infrastructure, parks, recreational areas, and retail spaces. The project supports national objectives to enhance urban quality of life and economic diversification in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030.

For Inquiries and submissions, please contact us via email at:
 kingfahadblvd@ashraq.sa
description.current_ncp_value: News Return to Media Center 27/08/2026 Previous Next RFQ Launched for King Fahd Suburb Boulevard PPP Project in Eastern Province Page Image Spanning approximately 1,000,000 m², the project will be developed in two phases, with a balanced allocation of a development plots, green spaces, and infrastructure facilities. Page Content Riyadh, August 2026 ​ – The Ministry of Municipalities and Housing (MOMAH), the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), and Ashraq Development Company, the development arm of the Eastern Province Municipality, are pleased to announce the launch of the Request for Qualification (RFQ) phase for the King Fahd Suburb Boulevard Project in the Eastern Province. This Public-Private Partnership (PPP) project will be delivered under a Design, Build, Finance, Operate, Maintain, and Transfer (DBFOMT) model, with a contract term of 43 years. Located in Al Bayda Governorate in the Eastern Province, the project spans approximately 1,000,000 m² and will be developed in two phases, with a balanced allocation of development plots, green spaces, and infrastructure facilities. The project also features a 4 km integrated mixed-use zone along a central boulevard and linear parklands, forming part of a larger 7.3 km corridor. Leveraging its strategic location and potential to deliver a unique urban experience, the private sector partner will be responsible for developing and operating a comprehensive mixed-use environment. This will include leisure and recreational facilities, public parks, entertainment venues, retail outlets, office spaces, and road networks—all designed to foster a vibrant environment in the Eastern Province. ​​The project is poised to redefine the urban landscape of the King Fahd Suburb in Dammam, advancing Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030 goals to enhance quality of life, drive sustainable development, and increase private sector participation in municipal infrastructure. For more information about the project, interested parties can visit the Investors Portal on the NCP website at: www.Investors.ncp.gov.sa For inquiries or submissions, you may reach out via email at kingfahadblvd@ashraq.sa The deadline for submitting the Statement of Qualification (SOQ) is 22 October 2026 at 11:59​ Share | Print

description.current_ncp_value: News Return to Media Center 11/05/2025 Previous Next MoD and NCP Launch EOI and RFQ for Riyadh Administrative Office Project Page Image announce the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) and Request for Qualification (RFQ) phase for the Riyadh Administrative Office Project for MoD personnel Page Content ​ Riyadh, May 2025: The Ministry of Defense (MoD), in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), is pleased to announce the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) and Request for Qualification (RFQ) phase for the Riyadh Administrative Office Project for MoD personnel. The project will be developed through a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model under a Design, Build, Finance, and Maintain (DBFM) contract. The contract term will extend for 27.5 years, after which the project will be transferred to the Ministry. Located in North Riyadh, the project covers approximately 52,793 square meters and will accommodate about 4,500 employees, with 3,200 dedicated parking spaces. The private sector partner will be responsible for the design, construction, and maintenance of the office buildings and supporting infrastructure, as well as coordinating with stakeholders and obtaining the required permits from the government. The project aims to establish a high-quality, sustainable work environment that aligns with modern design standards. MoD and NCP invite local and international investors to visit the NCP website at (www.ncp.gov.sa) for more information about the project and to request the RFQ document. Interested investors should submit their Statement of Qualification (SOQ) by 3 June, 2025, at 3:00 p.m. KSA time. ​ ​ Share | Print

The Saudi Broadcasting Authority (SBA) in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP) is pleased to invite submissions of expressions of interest from interested parties for the proposed rehabilitation,
operation and maintenance of SBA’s Television & Radio (FM and DAB+) Towers Infrastructure (Project) pursuant to a public-private partnership across 143 sites in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
description.current_ncp_value: News Return to Media Center 06/09/2024 Previous Next Saudi Broadcasting Authority, National Center for Privatization & PPP Launch Expression of Interest Phase for Television & Radio Towers Infrastructure PPP Project in 143 Locations Page Image ​​The Saudi Broadcasting Authority (SBA), in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) Page Content ​​ The Saudi Broadcasting Authority (SBA), in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) phase for the Television & Radio Towers Infrastructure PPP project to develop and operate the SBA towers infrastructure by the private sector under a Rehabilitate-Finance-Operate-Maintain-Transfer (RFOMT) contract model with a 25 years contract. The project is considered one of the Public-Private-Partnership (PPP) projects aimed to enhance the performance of the TV and radio towers infrastructure for the media sector in the Kingdom at 143 locations and increasing the number of TV and radio channels by qualifying and upgrading all TV sites from (DVB-T/Analogue) to (DVB-T2), with the aim of increasing the number of high-quality channels, and maintaining and operating the TV and radio towers infrastructure. SBA and NCP invited investors and interested parties to review the EOI document - containing project information - by visiting the NCP website, ( www.ncp.gov.sa ), noting that the EOI submission phase will end on 21 July, 2024, at 3:00 PM KSA time. Share | Print

description.portal_value: Zakat, Tax, and Customs Authority (ZATCA), in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), is pleased to invite EOI from interested parties for the Water and Sewage Treatment Plants project at Land Ports in the Kingdom. This project entails the design, development, operation, and maintenance of water and sewage treatment plants, as well as associated networks and assets, across 10 of the Kingdom’s land ports. Through the Water and Sewage Treatment Plants project, ZATCA aims to provide quality water and sewage treatment services to government personnel working at the land ports, ensuring that the quality of life at the land ports meets the criteria set out by the Vision 2030.
description.current_ncp_value: News Return to Media Center 09/06/2024 Previous Next ZATCA, in collaboration with NCP, launch EOI for Water and Sewage Treatment Plants PPP Project at 10 Land Ports Page Image Riyadh, June 2024: Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) Page Content Riyadh, June 2024: Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) phase for Water and Sewage Treatment Plants Project at Land Ports through a Public-Private-Partnership (PPP). The project will be tendered under a Design-Build-Finance-Operate-Maintain-Transfer (DBFOMT) model, with a contract duration of 15 years, including the construction period. The project will be implemented on ten land ports across the Kingdom. These include Al Batha, Salwa, Al Khafji, Al Raqi, Jadidat Arar, Al Hadithah, Halat Ammar, Al Durrah, Al Wadiah, and Empty Quarter. The project encompasses the design, construction, expansion, and refurbishment of plants and related assets, including networks. Additionally, it will include the supervision of the construction activities. In addition to the above, the project involves overseeing the daily operations of the plants and related assets, management of network operations, recording and reporting on operations, and ensuring alternative water and sewage treatment supply in case of interruption. Furthermore, it includes the performance of preventive maintenance for plants, networks, and related assets, cleaning of civil structures and plants, provision of spare parts and replacements, recording and reporting of maintenance, execution of lifecycle replacements and repairs, and monitoring of maintenance activities. ZATCA and NCP invite local and international investors interested in the project to visit the NCP website and review the EOI document. All interested companies should submit their EOI by 30, June 2024 at 3:00 pm KSA time. ​ Share | Print

description.portal_value: Zakat Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA), in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), is pleased to announce the launch of the development of hybrid power plant at Empty Quarter (Rub’al Khali) land port, which aims to minimize use of diesel fuel by using renewable energy and fulfil long term power supply needs at the Empty Quarter land port through a PPP model inline with Kingdom’s Vision 2030.
description.current_ncp_value: News Return to Media Center 11/06/2024 Previous Next ZATCA and NCP Launch RFQ for Power Plant PPP Project at Empty Quarter (Rub'al Khali) Land Port Page Image Zakat, Tax, and Customs Authority (ZATCA), in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), launched the Request for Qualification (RFQ) Page Content Zakat, Tax, and Customs Authority (ZATCA), in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), launched the Request for Qualification (RFQ) phase for the development of a hybrid power plant at the Empty Quarter land port (Rub'al Khali). The project aims to reduce the use of diesel fuel by using renewable energy and ensure long term power supply at the Empty Quarter land port through a Public-Private-Partnership (PPP) in line with the Kingdom's Vision 2030. ZATCA stated that the project will be implemented in partnership with the private sector, under a Design-Build-Finance-Operate-Maintain-Transfer (DBFOMT) contract model for a term of 25 years in addition to the construction period. The project involves designing, developing, operating, and maintaining a power generation facility at the Empty Quarter land port to meet ZATCA's electricity demand and technical specifications. This includes ensuring that the facility operates in accordance with the defined requirements and output specifications, as well as managing power generation and connection to the ZATCA interface point for the specified term of the project. Interested parties can request the RFQ document, by submitting the request form via NCP's website, www.ncp.gov.sa. Furthermore, the submission phase for the RFQ will remain open until July 21, 2024 at 3:00pm KSA time. Share | Print

description.portal_value:
Under the catchment area of the Second Health Cluster (R2), The hospital’s building and part of the medical and non-medical equipment are provided by the Saudi Basic Industries Corporation (SABIC) social responsibility program; the exclusive supporting partner.

The MoH is seeking a specialized private-sector operator, based on a PPP model, to operate (clinical and non-clinical operation) and maintain the hospital, and provide some of the medical and non-medical equipment. The hospital is being built on an area of 62,500 square meters, with a capacity of 150 beds, including and includes 5 inpatient treatment rooms, 19 outpatient clinics, and 6 daycare treatment rooms. The hospital will provide specialized health care services to adults and adolescent adolescents in the field of mental health and substance addiction treatment for both genders.

sector.portal_value: Human Resources and Social Development Sector

description.portal_value: The project aims to deliver residential services, social care, and facilities management services aligned with prevailing international best practices and approaches for delivering such services to people with disabilities. The project provides 150 Social Care Homes within both Riyadh and Jeddah to support 559 individuals with varying degrees of disabilities. The SCHs will support beneficiaries to live quality, meaningful lives, encouraging their autonomy and respecting their lifestyle choices and personal preferences in a “person-centered” approach to care. This initiative comes in line with Saudi 2030 vision and the Ministry’s transition from a service provider to a service regulator.

description.portal_value: Zakat, Tax, and Customs Authority (ZATCA), in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), is pleased to invite submissions of Expressions of Interest from interested parties for the Residential Buildings project at Land Ports in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This project entails the design, development, operation, and maintenance of residential areas across 9 of the Kingdom’s land ports.
description.current_ncp_value: News Return to Media Center 12/06/2024 Previous Next ZATCA, in collaboration with NCP, launch EOI for Residential Buildings PPP Project at Land Ports Page Image Riyadh, June 2024: Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) Page Content Riyadh, June 2024: Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) phase for the Residential Buildings Project at Land Ports through Public-Private-Partnership (PPP). The project will be tendered under a Design-Build-Finance-Operate-Maintain-Transfer (DBFOMT) model, with a contract duration of 23 years, including the construction period. The project will be implemented at nine (9) land ports across the Kingdom. These include Al Batha, Salwa, Al Raqi, Jadidat Arar, Al Hadithah, Halat Ammar, Al Durrah, Al Wadiah, and Empty Quarter. The project encompasses the comprehensive development and management of residential areas at land ports. It includes designing and constructing new housing units and service facilities, rehabilitating existing ones, and maintaining all structures throughout the contract period. Additionally, the project encompasses providing security services, operating health clubs, and creating a vibrant community atmosphere by ensuring access to parks and entertainment spaces within the residential areas. ZATCA and NCP invite local and international investors interested in the project to visit the NCP website and review the EOI document. All interested companies should submit their EOI by 30, June 2024 at 3:00 pm KSA time.​ Share | Print

Through the National Transport and Logistics Strategy and the National Aviation Strategy, the Kingdom seeks to strengthen its position among the leading nations as a global logistics hub connecting three continents. description.current_ncp_value: News Return to Media Center 02/12/2024 Previous Next MATARAT Holding, in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP) announce the launch of Expression of Interest (EOI) phase for the New Taif International Airport Page Image Expression of Interest (EOI) for the new Taif International Airport project. Page Content ​ Riyadh, December 2024: MATARAT Holding, in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP) is pleased to announce the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) for the new Taif International Airport project. This invitation is open to interested private sector entities in a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model under a Build-Transfer-Operate (BTO) contract for a period of 30 years inclusive of the construction period. This Project is in line with Vision 2030's goals, which aims to enhance the growth of the aviation sector in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Through the National Transport and Logistics Strategy and the National Aviation Strategy, the Kingdom seeks to strengthen its position among the leading nations as a global logistics hub connecting three continents. The new Taif International Airport will be located 21 km southeast of the existing Taif Airport, with a capacity to accommodate 2.5 million passengers by 2030. The Project scope includes (BTO) model of the new airport. The proposed design features a runway with a full-length-parallel taxiway, that connects to a single commercial apron. The new Taif International Airport will include a well-equipped commercial passenger terminal building aligned with the airport's projected capacity and demand, along with facility buildings, utility networks, car parks, and access roads that enable the standard operation of the airport. The project includes additional expansions to meet future subsystem requirements. The new Taif International Airport is expected to meet the projected increase in demand by 2055. It is also expected to meet the needs of Umrah pilgrims as a viable alternative within the region's multi-airport system. This system includes King Abdulaziz Airport in Jeddah, Prince Mohammed bin Abdulaziz Airport in Madinah, and Prince Abdulmohsen bin Abdulaziz Airport in Yanbu. The new Taif International Airport will contribute to the economic development of Taif city and its surrounding areas, in line with the National Aviation Strategy, as a highly efficient airport offering a top-quality passenger experience MATARAT Holding and NCP invite interested investors to review the EOI document containing project information by visiting the NCP's website (www.ncp.gov.sa). The deadline for submission of EOIs is January 10 2025, at 3:00 p.m. KSA time.​​ ​ Share | Print

By hiring and training skilled inspectors and providing them with the necessary tools and vehicles, the project will improve the quality, efficiency, effectiveness, and nationwide coverage of environmental inspections. In addition, it will support the digitalization of environmental inspection processes, ensuring data security while promoting sustainability, operational efficiency, and the digital transformation of environmental monitoring. Interested investors are invited to visit the National Center for Environment Compliance website at (www.ncec.gov.sa) to view the Expression of Interest (EOI) document.

description.portal_value: The Ministry of interior (MOI), in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), has announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) phase for Driving Schools Monitoring and Test Management project through Public-Private-Partnership (PPP). This project aims to monitor the performance of driving schools and administer driving tests in the Kingdom, with the objective of enhancing the quality and efficiency of driving tests and raise the standards of driving schools
description.current_ncp_value: News Return to Media Center 28/07/2024 Previous Next launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) phase for Driving Schools Monitoring and Test Management project through Public-Private Partnership (PPP) Page Image Riyadh, July 2024: The Ministry of interior (MOI), in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) Page Content Riyadh, July 2024: The Ministry of interior (MOI), in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) phase for Driving Schools Monitoring and Test Management project through Public-Private Partnership (PPP). This project aims to monitor the performance of driving schools and administer driving tests in the Kingdom, with the key objective of enhancing the quality and efficiency of driving tests and raise the standards of driving schools. There are currently more than 69 driving schools throughout the Kingdom. The project will be tendered under an operation and management (O&M) model, with a contract duration of 10 years, including 18 months for the project implementation. The project involves both driving test management and driving school monitoring. It includes operating and managing driving tests, which encompasses, pre-evaluation, theoretical, and practical tests, arranging necessary equipment, preparing tests based on the General Department of Traffic guidelines, and training testing staff, including examiners and assessors. Additionally, it involves developing standards for evaluating driving schools and trainers, conducting on-site evaluations, monitoring performance and compliance with key performance indicators (KPIs). It includes developing action plans for driving schools' improvement and submission of reports to the Ministry of interior and the General department of Traffic. Ministry of Interior and National Center for Privatization & PPP invited local and international investors interested in the project to visit the NCP website and review the EOI document. All interested companies should submit their EOI by 25 August 2024 at 3:00pm KSA time. Share | Print

description.portal_value: The Roads General Authority (RGA), in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), is pleased to announce the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) phase for the Road Operations and Maintenance (O&M) and Motorway Services Areas (MSA) development of Jeddah – Makkah Direct Highway. The newly built highway consists of a dual 4 lane road spanning 64 km. The highway also includes 4 MSAs (2 in each direction). The tender aims to attract the best in-class road construction companies, to be delivered to the highest standards of traffic safety and quality, in line with the Roads Strategy and the National Transport and Logistics Strategy (NTLS).
description.current_ncp_value: News Return to Media Center 07/10/2024 Previous Next RGA and NCP Launch EOI for Jeddah - Makkah Direct Highway Project Page Image Riyadh, October 2024: Following the approval of the Supervisory Committee for Privatization in the Transport and Logistic Services Page Content Riyadh, October 2024: Following the approval of the Supervisory Committee for Privatization in the Transport and Logistic Services, chaired by H.E. Eng. Saleh bin Nasser Al-Jasser, Minister of Transport and Logistics Services and Chairman of the Roads General Authority (RGA), the RGA, in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) phase for the Jeddah-Makkah Direct Highway project and its associated Motorway Services Areas (MSAs). The tender aims to attract the best in-class road construction companies, to be delivered to the highest standards of traffic safety and quality, in line with the Roads Strategy and the National Transport and Logistics Strategy (NTLS). RGA highlighted that the project will be executed through a public-private partnership (PPP) model, involving an Operations and Maintenance (O&M) contract for the Jeddah-Makkah Highway, along with a Design, Build, Finance, Operate, and Maintain (DBFOM) contract for new service areas on both sides of the highway, with a contract term of 10 years. It aims to operate and maintain the Jeddah-Makkah Direct Road, which consists of four lanes in each direction, spanning a distance of 64 kilometers, and includes six intersections, one camel crossing, and five vehicle overpasses. The project also includes the construction, operation, and maintenance of four service areas on both sides of the road. The Authority stated that the road will significantly serve pilgrims and Umrah performers heading to Makkah, as it is one of the shortest routes connecting Jeddah to the Holy City, taking just 35 minutes. The road will also contribute to supporting logistics and tourism in the region and will help maintain the Kingdom’s standing on the Global Connectivity Index. RGA and NCP invite local and international investors interested in road construction to learn about the project by visiting the NCP website and reviewing the EOI document on the project page. All interested companies should submit their EOI by October 24, 2024 at 3:00pm KSA time. -END- Share | Print

description.portal_value: Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), announced the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) phase for K9 Training Center and PoEs project through public private partnerships (PPPs). The project involves development and operation of the National K9 Training Center (NTC) at a central location in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, including the establishment of new K9 facilities at King Abdullah port in King Abdullah Economic City and King Abdulaziz Port in Dammam, with the expansion of the existing K9 facilities at Jeddah Islamic Seaport and provision of facilities maintenance services at these three existing PoEs. Additionally, the project involves maintaining and operating the NTC while providing K9 training and other services such as food, equipment, vet-care, and accommodation. The K9 services will be provided at 34 PoEs across the Kingdom, including 26 existing ports and an additional eight expected to become operational by 2030.

description.portal_value:
This project, which will be implemented in the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model, aims to develop and manage a fully integrated national digital platform across the Kingdom to support the
waste management system across all its stages, and serves as a unified regulatory hub for data collection, reporting, information analysis, compliance monitoring, and enhancing coordination among
relevant entities, thereby ensuring operational efficiency, effective performance, and sustainability of operations.

Interested investors may apply for the project through the National Center for Waste Management (MWAN) website via the following link: https://mwan.gov.sa/ltkhsys
description.current_ncp_value: News Return to Media Center 15/04/2026 Previous Next MWAN and NCP Launch EOI for Development and Operation of the National Digital Waste Management Platform Page Image A PPP project to develop a unified digital platform enhancing waste management efficiency across the Kingdom. Page Content Riyadh: April 2026 - The National Center for Waste Management (MWAN), in collaboration with the Ministry of Environment, Water & Agriculture (MEWA), the Environment Fund, and the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), is pleased to announce the launch of Expression of Interest (EOI) stage to develop and operate the National Digital Waste Management Platform under a PPP framework (Design, Build, Finance, Operate, Maintain, and Transfer) for a contract duration of 11 years, inviting local and global companies and investors to review the opportunity and submit their responses. This project represents a strategic milestone aimed at strengthening the planning, regulation, monitoring, and optimization of waste management activities across the Kingdom. Under the project, the private sector partner will be responsible for designing, developing, financing, operating, and maintaining a nationwide integrated digital platform, enabling effective coordination, governance, and integration across the entire waste management value chain. The project scope includes the deployment of a comprehensive suite of digital services, comprising seven (7) core business applications with twenty-seven (27) functional modules. The platform will support user and stakeholder management, customer classification, licensing systems, electronic waste tracking (e-manifest), regulatory reporting and data analytics, marketplace functionalities, and smart contracts. The platform will serve as a centralized system covering data collection, reporting, analytics, compliance monitoring, and stakeholder integration across the waste management value chain. The project aims to expand digital coverage of waste management activities, enhance operational efficiency and service quality, and streamline regulatory and compliance processes. This initiative reinforces Saudi Arabia's commitment to sustainable and efficient waste management practices and supports the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030 by advancing sustainability and accelerating digital transformation within the sector. Local and international investors, financial institutions, and operators are invited to visit the MWAN website at https://mwan.gov.sa/ for more information about the project and to request the EOI document. Interested investors should submit their EOI by 6 May 2026, at 11:59 PM KSA time. ​ Share | Print

description.portal_value:
Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA), in collaboration with the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), is pleased to announce the launch of the Expression of Interest (EOI) and Request for Qualification (RFQ) phase for Development and Operations of Customs Warehouses Project in 38 Points of Entry (PoEs) across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
ZATCA aims through this project to enhance the Kingdom's position as a global logistics hub by promoting trade and maintaining public safety, in line with the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030.

description.portal_value: This Public-Private Partnership (PPP) project aims to rehabilitate, operate, maintain, and partially commercialize 50 public neighborhood parks across three regions in Saudi Arabia. The project seeks to enhance the quality, accessibility, and sustainability of municipal parks, while improving user experience, enabling commercial activation. It also contributes to delivering high-quality municipal services, fostering urban sustainability, and promoting a balanced living environment in line with the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030.
